hero.headline: Furnace and AC repair in {city}
hero.subhead: Call and talk to a person. Most no-heat calls get a tech the same day, and you hear the price before any work starts.

fear.fear: Paying more than you were told
fear.answer: The price is quoted before work starts. What we quote is what you pay.

services.name: Furnace repair
services.summary: No heat, short cycling or strange noises, diagnosed and fixed.
services.whenNeeded: The furnace won't start, keeps shutting off, or the house won't warm up.
services.differentiator: Most repairs finish on the first visit.

services.name: Furnace installation
services.summary: A new high-efficiency furnace sized to your house.
services.whenNeeded: Your furnace is past 15 years old or repairs keep adding up.
services.differentiator: Sized from a heat-loss calculation, not a guess.

services.name: Air conditioning
services.summary: AC tune-ups, repairs and new installs.
services.whenNeeded: The AC blows warm, freezes up, or hasn't been serviced in two summers.

services.name: Maintenance plan
services.summary: One furnace and one AC check a year, with priority booking.
services.whenNeeded: You'd rather not find out the furnace is failing on the coldest night.
services.differentiator: Plan members are booked first on no-heat calls.
